name: ZCA_INTG_MAPS
description: This table is used to store mapping identifier, source and target application information.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_MAP_ID
columns.description: This column signifies the map id of the record. This is the primary key.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_MAP_NAME
columns.description: This column signifies the name of the integration map.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column signifies the description of the map.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_MAPPING_NUMBER
columns.description: This column signifies the PUID. It is a unique contraint.

columns.name: CONNECTION_REF
columns.description: This column holds the integration connections and endpoints.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_URI
columns.description: This column holds the Target URI pointing to endpoint.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_ACTION
columns.description: This column holds the rest operation on endpoint_uri.

columns.name: ENDPOINT_HEADERS
columns.description: This column holds the header info for endpoint_uri.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION
columns.description: This column signifies source application where it will be mapped.

columns.name: TARGET_APPLICATION
columns.description: This column signifies the target application where it will be mapped.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT
columns.description: This column signifies the source object which will be mapped.

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT
columns.description: This column signifies the target object which will mapped.

columns.name: TARGET_ENDPOINT
columns.description: This column signifies To support user defined endpoints on the target that fit into application/json.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: This column signifies whether a mapping is seeded or not.

columns.name: INTEGRATION_SUB_STEP
columns.description: This column holds the name of integration such as CreateQuote,RenewQuote,ReConfigure and SubmitOrder.

columns.name: PARENT_MAP_NUMBER
columns.description: This column is a self reference column to INTEGRATION_MAPPING_NUMBER.

columns.name: AFTER_HANDLER
columns.description: This column holds the java class path to invoke after integration.

columns.name: BEFORE_HANDLER
columns.description: This column holds the java class path to invoke before integration.

columns.name: PROPERTY_FLAGS
columns.description: This column holds the bit mask indicator to differentiate properties like ActiveFlag,CloneFlag.If the column has a value of 3 then it can be treated as bit 11.

columns.name: EVENT_STAGE
columns.description: The event types of signal definitions that will be created for the integration. The possible values are ORA_CREATE, ORA_UPDATE, ORA_UPSERT and ORA_DELETE.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the signal definition that was created for the integration.

columns.name: MAP_TF_SPEC
columns.description: This column signifies json spec to perform mapping and transformation.

columns.name: MAPPING_RULE
columns.description: The condition used when defining signal definition for the integration.

columns.name: MAP_URL_SPEC
columns.description: This column signifies json spec to perform mapping and transformation on URL parameters.

columns.name: SEED_MAP_TF_SPEC
columns.description: This column holds the seeded json specification to perform mapping and transformation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: The schedule details of the integration. (If integration is executed as a batch).

columns.name: INTEGRATION_CHANNEL
columns.description: This column holds a value that indicates the channel that will be used to synchronize data with the target application. The channels supported are file upload and REST.
